question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment can arise for a practitioner
This accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginis
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginis.
